name: sensitive_scan
description: Scan a (possibly nested) archive for sensitive data: phone numbers, emails, ID-card numbers and API keys. Counts total occurrences (no dedup) across text files via deterministic regex, and across images via structured multimodal extraction with code validation.

zip_path.description: Path to the archive declared in the question (e.g. 'sensitive_data_2_1.zip'). Relative paths resolve against the question directory.

do_ocr.description: Whether to extract sensitive tokens from images via the model gateway and add their counts. Defaults to true; set false for a pure-offline deterministic text-only scan.
